description: The Neural Jack Lounge is a circular arrangement of padded seating, drinks tables and luminous displays. A round blue transport platform stands in the middle, surrounded by purple pools of light and curving rows of lounge seats. The upper wall carries a Neural Jack Lounge sign between tall illuminated columns. A long bar curves across the lower half, with stools beneath it and shelves of glowing bottles behind. Transparent-looking display columns, bright screens and small potted plants fill the outer alcoves. A marked entrance is visible on the right; the rich violet lighting and the repeated circular forms distinguish this lounge from the ship's plainer metal decks.
